name: glMatrix
category: A9. Adjacent resources mentioned during discovery
summary: High-performance vector, matrix and quaternion library for JavaScript, using Float32Array and in-place operations. It has no rendering or timeline: it supplies projection, view and transform maths to raw WebGL or WebGPU code. Pure functions of their inputs, so safe in seek-driven frames.
use_when: Raw WebGL or WebGPU scenes needing matrices without a framework
Over hand-rolled maths in custom shader pipelines
Quaternion slerp for camera paths in non-Three.js renderers
avoid_when: Three.js scenes: its own Matrix4 and Quaternion are built in
Lightweight WebGL: OGL and twgl ship their own maths
Animated values over time: GSAP, not matrices

assessment.rationale: Maintained (3.4.4 Aug 2025, commits Jul 2026) and stable, but a supporting math library, not a scene tool. Three.js, OGL and twgl bundle equivalent vec/mat types, so it earns a place only for raw WebGL.
